title: Music
tagline: Awards season, the big drops and the end-of-year lists.
subject: Pop culture

briefing.headline: The 2027 Grammy nominations were announced on 16 November, and they are the main music story this week.

points.text: The 2027 Grammy nominations were announced on Monday, 16 November. Watch the full list on grammy.com.
points.label: reported

points.text: Raye leads the nominations with 11, and Olivia Rodrigo has 7, according to one fan comment.
points.label: fan view

points.text: Dolly Parton has 3 posthumous Grammy nominations and will compete against herself.
points.label: reported

points.text: Noah Kahan got one folk nomination. He said he was 'in my feelings for a sec' about being left out of the bigger categories.
points.label: reported

points.text: Don Toliver's sixth album, Nitrous, comes out on 4 December. He has five Grammy nominations.
points.label: reported
